instructions: Prioritize clear correctness bugs, runtime errors, agent/tool contract regressions, TypeScript schema mismatches, srcwalk command behavior, bounded output, registry/id handoff, path/platform handling, and npm release workflow safety. Avoid speculative edge cases, style nits, and broad refactor suggestions.

rules.rule: Tool output shown to agents should stay bounded and use truncation/registry handoff instead of dumping large source or command output, except for explicit semantic_show source reads.
Tool parameter schemas, descriptions, injected prompt contract, README examples, and implementation behavior should stay aligned.
Release workflow changes should preserve tag-only publishing, minimal permissions, version checks, npm provenance/trusted publishing, and safe skip behavior for already-published versions.
